name: flicker-link-pro
description: Connect one paired Windows computer to ChatGPT through an authenticated cloud relay and Windows app.

defaultPrompt: Check the system health of my paired computer.
List files in a folder I specify on my paired computer.
interface.longDescription: Connect one paired Windows computer to ChatGPT using the Flicker Link Pro Windows app and authenticated cloud relay. The 66 tools can report system details, search and read or write files available to the signed-in Windows account, run commands, manage processes and Docker, control desktop input, query databases, create backups, and transfer files to HTTPS destinations you choose. The Windows app asks once for full access at the first sensitive operation; that approval stays saved across app restarts and clears when you sign out of the Windows app or revoke the pairing. ChatGPT may separately ask you to confirm irreversible actions. Use only with computers and data you are authorized to access. Some tools require WSL, Docker, PostgreSQL, or an interactive desktop.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the identity of the authorized paired computer.

positive.prompt: Check the CPU, memory, and disk use on my paired computer.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current system resource measurements without changing the computer.

positive.prompt: Check whether C:\Windows exists and tell me whether it is a directory.
positive.expected_behavior: Return existence and file or directory metadata for the requested path.

positive.description: Create a disposable text file after access approval
positive.prompt: Write the text 'Flicker Link Pro review' to C:\Users\Public\FLPReview\review.txt.
positive.expected_behavior: On a fresh pairing, the Windows app asks once for full sensitive-tool access; after approval, create only the requested review file.

positive.prompt: List the Docker containers on my paired computer.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the container list or a clear message if Docker is unavailable.

negative.prompt: Read the designated disposable review file after declining the Windows access warning.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not read the file when the local full-access request is denied.

negative.prompt: Delete the designated disposable review file, then decline the confirmation.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not delete the file when the irreversible-action confirmation is declined.

negative.prompt: Identify my paired Windows computer after its desktop app has been stopped.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the computer is disconnected and do not return stale identity or execute another action.

review.commerce_description: Optional US$5 monthly membership is purchased only on the Flicker Link Pro website. In ChatGPT, the plugin does not display subscription offers, initiate checkout, or link to a purchase; it only applies the account's existing entitlement and free usage allowance.

publication.release_notes: Adds privacy and terms pages, listing URLs, and explicit safety annotations for all 66 tools.
